title: Contour Next One meter uploads duplicate BG readings
symptom: Duplicate glucose readings appear in the Calibration Data Table, not all the time, and when it happens, it may happen anywhere between 1 and 5 or 6 times. The entries can be minutes or hours apart.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One commenter suggests it may be related to Bluetooth glucose meters and describes a similar issue with an Accu-Check Aviva Connect where historic glucose levels are suddenly populated at a wrong time. Another commenter identifies triggering conditions: meter connected to xDrip, automatic calibration enabled, doing a BG test without calibrating, then opening xDrip after 30 minutes causes the earlier BG value to be randomly applied as calibration.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. A workaround mentioned is disabling automatic calibration or clicking on BG in graph and calibrating every BG or deleting BG.
evidence_quote: Workaround seems to be disabling automatic calibration or click on BG in graph and calibrate every BG or delete BG.
